subject: Game Theory
title: Trust and AI
description: A quick, practical guide to Trust and AI.

hook.text: A self-driving car must choose: swerve into a wall or hit a pedestrian. Do you trust the AI's judgment?

buildup.text: AI trust has layers: does the AI work correctly, does it act ethically, and can we verify its reasoning?

discovery.text: Research shows people overtrust AI when it's framed as 'intelligent' and undertrust it after a single visible error.

twist.text: The 'algorithm aversion' paradox: people reject algorithms that outperform humans after seeing them make one mistake.

climax.text: Building trustworthy AI requires transparency, auditing, and allowing human override—trust by design, not by faith.

punchline.text: AI earns trust the hard way: one decision at a time.

quiz.question: What is algorithm aversion?
options: Rejecting algorithms after one error despite overall superiority
